Visit Us: Open Events and Tours
We warmly invite prospective parents to join us for a tour of Thames Ditton Infant School and see our school in action.
Our tours are a wonderful opportunity to hear from our Headteacher, Mrs Leach, visit our classrooms, see our children engaged in their learning and explore our shared indoor and outdoor spaces. There will also be plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get a real sense of what makes Thames Ditton Infant School such a special place to learn and grow.
Upcoming Tour Dates
Tours start promptly at 9:00am. Please arrive a few minutes early and report to the front desk.
Tuesday 13 October 2026 – 9:00am
Thursday 5 November 2026 – 9:00am
Tuesday 17 November 2026 – 9:00am
What to Expect
Your visit will begin with a short welcome talk from our Headteacher, Mrs Leach, followed by a guided tour in a small group, led by one of our senior members of staff.
The tour will last approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Important Information
Mainstream School Tours
Please note that these tours are for our mainstream school provision and do not include The Nest, our specialist SEND provision.
If you are interested in a place in The Nest, please contact the school office directly for further information and to discuss visiting.
Book Your Tour
Places on our prospective parent tours must be booked in advance.
BOOK YOUR TOUR ON TICKETSOURCE
We look forward to welcoming you and showing you around our school!
Applying for an In-Year Place
If your child is seeking an in-year place at Thames Ditton Infant School, you may be able to arrange a personal tour as part of your admissions enquiry. Please contact the School Office on 020 8398 5842, and we’ll be happy to advise you.
For families applying for a Reception place for September 2027, please book one of our scheduled prospective parent tours above. We are unable to offer individual tours for Reception applications.

pageCache.text:
Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS)
Welcome to Reception!
A very warm welcome to all our new families—we are so pleased that you and your child will be joining us! We cannot wait to meet you and begin this exciting journey together.
This page is especially for you, and we hope you’ll find it helpful as you prepare for your child to start in Reception. We understand that this can be a time filled with both excitement and nerves, but please rest assured—it is our priority to ensure that both you and your child feel confident, supported, and ready for this new chapter.
At Thames Ditton Infant School, your child’s happiness and development are at the heart of everything we do. We believe children learn best when they feel safe, are having fun, and are encouraged to explore and grow.
Our Early Years Foundation Stage is all about sparking curiosity and inspiring a love of learning. Through hands-on, meaningful experiences, we help children become independent, inquisitive problem-solvers with a strong sense of self and a positive attitude to learning.
We are so excited to welcome you to our school family!

EYFS Curriculum
At Thames Ditton Infant School, we believe that every child deserves the very best start to their learning journey. Our EYFS curriculum provides children with a rich and engaging range of experiences that encourage curiosity, creativity, independence and a love of learning.
Through purposeful play, exploration and carefully planned experiences, children develop knowledge, skills and confidence across the seven areas of learning in the Early Years Foundation Stage. We build on what children already know and can do, while providing opportunities for them to develop their interests, ask questions and make connections in their learning.
Our curriculum is designed to support every child to grow and develop as a confident, resilient and independent learner, ready for the next stage of their education.
